title: Official outcomes for cross-layer scoring — EMPTY until canvasses are certified
capturedFrom: to be filled from the official canvass sources listed in officialSources (never from a news call, never from a market settlement)
method: Scoring is blocked until each question has y=0|1, certifiedOn, and sources with sourceId, HTTPS url on that verified government authority origin, kind=certified-canvass, certificationQuote and retrievedAt. Dates must be valid, certification must follow election day and be available by asOf. All forecasts (including layer timestamps) must precede election day UTC. Brier uses exact valid probabilities; only log-loss clips endpoints. Registry resultOrigins can authorize a verified vendor/CDN origin. This is a structural/provenance gate, not automatic proof that text establishes a winner. Derive chamber control from certified contest results and carried seats under the question resolution rules, never from a news call or Kalshi settlement. The repository does not yet have jurisdiction-specific automatic canvass ingestion. See backtest/crosslayer-outcomes.md.

officialSources.name: National Association of Secretaries of State — canvass/certification links per state (master id nass)
U.S. House Clerk — official election statistics (master id clerk-house)
U.S. Senate (master id senate — url as verified in master.json; use the per-state SoS certification for the result itself)
